actions.text:
Hi Marcus — thanks for reaching out and for the kind words about my React work. I’m interested in this dashboard project; the scope you outlined (real-time visualizations, REST API integration, auth/role-based access, responsive/tablet support, and dark mode) is right in my wheelhouse.

A few quick questions so I can prepare a firm proposal:
• Do you have API docs or a sandbox I can review (rate limits, payloads, auth method)?
• Is the real-time feed via WebSockets/Server-Sent Events, or would you prefer polling? 
• Do you have authentication already (OAuth/JWT) or should I implement an auth system from scratch? 
• Any existing design system or component library you want me to use? 

Budget/timeline: your $5k–$6k budget and ~4 week timeline are reasonable depending on final scope. I can do a fixed-price engagement (I typically estimate this type of project around $5,500) or work hourly — whichever you prefer. I’m available to start next month and can block time for a 30-minute kickoff call to align on requirements.

If that sounds good, please share API access/docs and a couple of times that work for a call. I’ll also attach relevant portfolio links or a short proposal once I review the API.

Best,
Jordan Mitchell
ML Engineer — TechCorp Inc.
